prompt: Create an ultra-realistic premium editorial portrait of a young Black male executive with short neat black hair, smooth medium-dark skin, clean-shaven face, and calm confident expression seated confidently in a luxurious executive office. The subject sits centered in a black leather executive armchair, facing the camera directly with composed eye contact, one leg crossed, one hand relaxed on the chair arm, and the other holding a slim black notebook. Dress him in a tailored dark charcoal double-breasted pinstripe suit, crisp white dress shirt, deep emerald green tie, matching green pocket square, and silver wristwatch. Use a sophisticated modern office interior with warm wood paneling, built-in bookshelves, a large abstract painting, a broad executive desk, a conference table, polished marble floor, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Dubai skyline at sunset with the Burj Khalifa visible on the right. Lighting should feel expensive and cinematic: golden-hour sunset through the windows, warm recessed ceiling strip lights, soft fill on the face, natural skin texture, crisp suit fabric detail, realistic reflections on leather and marble. Composition should be a waist-to-full seated portrait in vertical 4:5 format, eye-level camera, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, premium business magazine cover aesthetic, sharp focus on the subject, background slightly softened but still recognizable. Mood: visionary, successful, composed, aspirational. No text, no logos, no watermark, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no artificial plastic skin.

promptZh:
创作一张超写实的优质编辑风格肖像，主角为 一位年轻的黑人男性高管，他自信地坐在豪华的现代行政办公室内。主体位于画面中心，直视镜头，表情冷静、专注且充满自信。他留着修剪整齐的黑色短发，拥有光滑的中深色皮肤、干净的面部、对称的五官，展现出沉稳的 CEO 气质。他身穿剪裁合身的炭黑色双排扣条纹西装，搭配挺括的白色衬衫、深祖母绿领带、同色系口袋巾、黑色正装袜以及一块精致的银色奢华腕表。他坐在黑色真皮行政扶手椅上，一条腿交叉，左手自然地放在扶手上，右手将一本纤薄的黑色笔记本放在膝盖上。

场景设定在 一间俯瞰迪拜的高层豪华行政办公室。他身后是落地窗，窗外是温暖的日落天际线，包括错落有致的摩天大楼和右侧一座类似哈利法塔的建筑。办公室内部装饰有深色胡桃木镶板、带有书籍和装饰性奖项的嵌入式书架、一幅大型抽象黑米色边框画、一盆盆栽、一张配有黄铜台灯的宽大木质行政办公桌、一张现代玻璃会议桌、黑色办公椅、大理石地面以及带有发光灯槽的温暖嵌入式天花板照明。利用窗户射入的黄金时段光线与柔和的电影感室内光线相结合，呈现皮革、玻璃、金属和大理石上的真实反射效果，采用浅景深、高端杂志封面风格、清晰的面部细节、自然的皮肤纹理、平衡的对比度以及高端的企业成功美学。采用竖构图肖像，腰部到全身的坐姿构图，平视视角，50mm 编辑镜头质感。避免出现文字、标志、水印、手部畸形、多余手指、不切实际的珠宝或夸张的面部修图。
